vars.v: exchange rate I-44, four-quarter change, % (up = weaker)

eqcm.label: EqCM (the model)
eqcm.desc: every equation re-estimated on the data to the origin; dynamic simulation with the exogenous variables and the policy rate at their actual values

dvar.label: dVAR (level terms dropped)
dvar.desc: the same equations with the equilibrium-correction and other level terms removed and re-estimated (EHN1999)

ic.label: EqCM, intercept-corrected
ic.desc: the model with each equation's last residual added to every forecast quarter (Clements–Hendry)

naive.label: No change
naive.desc: the reported variable stays at its origin-quarter value

ar.label: AR(4)
ar.desc: univariate AR(4) with constant for the reported variable, same expanding window

errors_note: errors[var][model][h]: actual minus forecast, one entry per origin in `paths[var].origins` (null where the target quarter is beyond the data).
note: Expanding-window re-estimation at every origin from 2007Q1 (77 origins), eight-quarter dynamic forecasts conditional on the actual paths of the exogenous variables and the policy rate; current data vintage. RMSFE in the units of each variable (percentage points). Diebold–Mariano: HAC variance with h − 1 Bartlett lags, Harvey–Leybourne–Newbold correction, two-sided p-values; a negative statistic means the model has the smaller squared errors.
